name: room-bench-stage-probe-a
refs: Our signed bench stage (project-owned): keep this exact frame, its sage enamel and sand trim, its corners, screws and plaques, its dark slate floor, its matte rendering and light. Same framing, edge to edge.
The same stage with the areas that must stay plain slate floor outlined in magenta (project-owned guide). Do not draw the magenta lines.
prompt: Repaint the first reference as the Probe's work bench: keep the frame, corners, screws, plaques and the dark slate floor exactly. On the floor, only along its bottom edge and at its far left and far right sides, add a few small field tools and small round gauges lying on the slate (a small screwdriver, a tiny wrench, two small dial gauges, a coil of thin cable), small and quiet, matte, same light. Everything inside the magenta outlines of the second reference stays plain empty slate floor, and nothing crosses those areas. No hoses, no device, no cradle, no screen, no glass, no glow, no text, no people, no hands. Same palette as the first reference.
